description: Change of use of archway to a sauna and cold plunge facility (Use Class E(d)), including use of associated enclosed yard area with external plant and equipment.
decision_conditions: <p>The use hereby permitted, or the operation of any plant (Odyssey Plunge Apex Chiller 6.5kW), shall not commence until a post-installation noise assessment has been carried out to confirm compliance with the noise criteria. The scheme shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and attenuation measures, and they shall be permanently retained and maintained in working order for the duration of the use and their operation. The plant shall thereafter be installed and maintained in accordance with the approved details.&nbsp;</p><p>Reason: To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers and the surrounding area&nbsp;</p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-64d107da-7fff-82c4-8a95-54bbd02bea48"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">No customer shall be on the premises other than between the hours of 07.00 until 22:00 - Monday to Sunday and 07.00 until 22.00 - Bank Holidays</span></span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-64d107da-7fff-82c4-8a95-54bbd02bea48"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;"> REASON: To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers and the surrounding area </span></span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">The floorspace shown on the approved plans to be used for Use Class E purposes shall be used for Class E purposes only and for no other use of the Town and Country (Use Classes) Order 1987 (or any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification). Furthermore, notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification) the floorspace within Use Class E shall not change use by any means under the Town and Country (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).&nbsp; REASON: To enable the local planning authority to retain control of the use and to ensure that other uses are not introduced without further assessment.</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-dafca77e-7fff-6e3e-97b1-eda1343a90aa"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The rated noise level from all plant and ancillary equipment shall not increase the existing background noise level (10dB below) when measured 1m external from the nearest residential or noise sensitive premises.&nbsp; The plant shall thereafter be installed and maintained in accordance with the approved details. Reason: To ensure that the use of any associated plant or equipment does not give rise to an unacceptable loss of amenity to neighboring occupiers.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-5714eb9c-7fff-1bfb-8fbb-0a9cd5d47a61"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">Prior to the first occupation of the use hereby permitted, and notwithstanding the details on the drawings and documents, a delivery and servicing plan for the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Those details shall include: i. How deliveries and general servicing will be managed; ii. Waste management and collection strategy </span></span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-5714eb9c-7fff-1bfb-8fbb-0a9cd5d47a61"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">Servicing shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details upon commencement of the use hereby permitted and for the lifetime of the development. </span></span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-5714eb9c-7fff-1bfb-8fbb-0a9cd5d47a61"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">REASON: To ensure that that servicing and management of refuse will be appropriate in the interest of protecting the amenity of the site, safety of the highway and the area in general from litter, odour and potential vermin/pest nuisance.</span></span></p>

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the use hereby permitted, light from the luminaires shall not exceed 10 EV (lux) within suburban surroundings (or 25 EV (lux) within urban surroundings) when measured at any residential or light sensitive window overlooking the development. All luminaries shall be oriented and designed in such a way to minimise light spillage beyond the boundary and prevent glare into the windows of residential or light sensitive properties overlooking the development. The applicant must submit light contour maps to show how the proposed lighting scheme will impact on the surrounding residents.&nbsp;</p><p>Reason: To protect residential amenity&nbsp;</p>
